metadata.title: Secure Identity Relying Party SSPP
metadata.remarks: Template for documenting how a system relies on Secure Identity assurance without independently implementing or evaluating identity services.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline. This SSPP documents reliance on identity services rather than control implementation.

system-characteristics.system-description: System or platform that consumes identity assertions and assurance signals provided by Secure Identity to inform access and trust decisions.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: This system relies on an institutionally approved Secure Identity Provider SSPP for identity assertions.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: This system consumes identity assurance as interpreted by the Secure Identity Assurance SSPP.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: Where applicable, this system relies on Secure Identity Federation SSPP for trust in externally asserted identities.

props.name: identity-consumption-model
props.remarks: The system consumes authenticated identity assertions together with dynamic assurance signals rather than static identity attributes.

props.name: assurance-requirement
props.remarks: Required identity assurance varies based on access context, operation sensitivity, and user role.

props.name: authorization-separation
props.remarks: Authorization decisions remain local to the system and are not delegated to the identity provider.

props.name: lifecycle-dependence
props.remarks: Access decisions depend on authoritative identity lifecycle state provided by Secure Identity.

props.name: trust-boundary
props.remarks: Identity proofing, authentication, and assurance computation occur outside this system.

props.name: delegation-consumption
props.remarks: Delegated access is honored only when explicitly asserted and auditable through Secure Identity.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: This system relies on identity assurance aligned to SP 800-63 authentication, proofing, and federation principles as interpreted by Secure Identity.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: The relying system enforces Zero Trust principles by continuously evaluating trust in supplied identity assertions and assurance context.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP does not implement identity controls. It documents reliance on externally provided identity and assurance signals.

components.title: Identity Relying Party
components.description: Conceptual component representing a system that consumes identity assertions from Secure Identity services.

roles.title: System Owner
roles.remarks: Accountable for defining how the system relies on identity assurance and authorizing acceptable risk thresholds.

roles.title: Identity Architecture Authority
roles.remarks: Ensures relying systems correctly interpret and consume Secure Identity assurance.

control-implementation.remarks: All identity-related controls are inherited from Secure Identity Provider, Federation, and Assurance SSPPs.
